messages:
Rita CSM: dropping a two-minute 'handback' checklist for go-live calls. aim: reduce churn by making prefill+streaming simple and repeatable.
Omar SRE: keep it hyper-short. include one probe command and one health formula.
Rita CSM: draft 5 bullets: preflight metrics, warm-probe, 3-sample warmup, enable adaptive defaults, 30m feedback + escalate.
Zoe Eng: runtime guidance: hydration=90s small / 5m medium. defaults: max_batch_size=16, batch_window_ms=150, latency_slo_ms=250, initial_concurrency=2. quant profile: chat -> latency-first.
Omar SRE: probe snippet for CS during demo:
```bash
# warm probe + tag traces
redwoodctl pools list --tenant=$TENANT --status=warm --short || echo 0
curl -s -X POST $CONSOLE/internal/tag -d "tenant=$TENANT&tag=cs-handback" -H "Authorization: Bearer $INT_TOKEN"
```
Rita CSM: simple health formula we can show on the CS card:
`health = 1 - clamp(0.6*(1 - prefill_hit_rate) + 0.3*(early_err_1m/0.01) + 0.1*(median_latency_ms/1000), 0, 1)`
Omar SRE: threshold: health < 0.6 -> escalate. escalation steps: run warm-probe, enable throttled-prefill, open support case and invite eng, offer 15m dedicated burst if available.
Zoe Eng: fallback: if streaming_disconnect_rate > 1% sustained for 10m -> switch to non-streaming, set batch_window_ms=400, notify eng-sre.
Rita CSM: feedback card (T+30m):
"Please answer: 1) Did outputs meet expectations? 2) Any repeated truncations or delays? 3) Which single prompt should we prefill next? Also paste any error IDs."
ops-bot: sys: handback preflight for tenant demo-221 at 3987655200 completed (warm_replicas=2) :white_check_mark:
Rita CSM: thanks all. i'll make this the quick handout for CS and link the console action once Zoe posts it. TL;DR for field: run probe, send 3 warmups, enable adaptive defaults, watch health card, escalate if health<0.6, collect 30m feedback.
